en: A dog-sized mudskipper with goggle eyes on top of a blunt head. It props its long body on its fins and skims the flats in bursts, faster than anything that size should be.

A reef crab that has moved into a broken Lit Age lamp housing, the way a hermit wears a shell. Its back glows a faint, still teal. The housing turns blows aside, and it can flash the old salt-glass in your eyes.
Hadric Moll, an Inquisitor of the Stillguard: an officer who enforces the Edicts. Red-lacquered shell armour, a white sash, a brine-iron on a long haft. Sincere, and tired.
An Order shoal-hound, mud-coloured, with a greyhound's legs under a mastiff's chest and a red-lacquered cage over its muzzle. It is trained to guard its handler.
The hound guards the Inquisitor. Draw it off.
Smoke blinds blades. Magic still finds its mark.
Toma will not strike the Stillguard.
A boxy hand-cranked launcher, wright-built from salvage. It throws bolts, hooks and anything else that fits.
A copper-mesh sleeve on the left arm that takes the sparks off a bad seal.
